title: Comparison of Length Gain Between Square Flap and Z-plasty in Post Burn Contracture Release
brief_summary: the purpose of this study is to compare the gain in length after postburn contracture release using two different techniques, the more commonly practised z - plasty and relatively newer technique, square flap
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:- • Both genders.

* Joints supple.
* Linear contracture bands.
* Age between 5years to 50 years.
* Surrounding non scarred skin.
* Contractures of axilla, cubital fossa, popliteal fossa and digits.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Deep burns.

  * Joint contractures.
  * Surrounding skin scarred.
  * Broad, irregular contracture.
  * Neck, Perineal, wrist or toe contractures
